The complete proof is Section 1 of the artifact.  It uses the standard facts
(S1)--(S4) of its Section 0.

**Moment criterion.**  A tracial von Neumann algebra generated by countably
many contractions is Connes embeddable if and only if every finite set of
generators admits contractions in some Connes embeddable algebra whose
`*`-moments of bounded length are arbitrarily close.  This is the standard
microstate criterion, and finite-dimensional C\*-algebras with faithful
traces are admissible targets.

**Clifford word reduction.**  In any algebra with the Clifford relations,
`tau(c_{y_1} ... c_{y_m})` is zero when some label has odd multiplicity.
Otherwise it is a sign computed from the equality pattern
`{(i,j) : y_i = y_j}` alone: move the first letter to its next occurrence
and cancel.

**Proof.**

1. Push all group unitaries to the right.  A word of length at most `n`
   becomes `c_{y_1} ... c_{y_m} u_q`, where `y_j = a_j x_{i_j}` for prefix
   products `a_j`.  Its trace is `delta_{q,e} tau(c_{y_1} ... c_{y_m})`.
2. For labels in a common orbit with representative `x_o`, `y_j = y_k` is
   equivalent to `d_{jk} in H_{x_o}` for an explicit group element `d_{jk}`.
3. Only finitely many `q` and `d_{jk}` occur.  Separability and residual
   finiteness give one finite-index normal `N`, the intersection of finitely
   many separating subgroups, with `q notin N` for `q != e` and
   `d notin H_{x_o} N` for each `d_{jk} notin H_{x_o}`.
4. Let `Q = H/N` and `Y = disjoint_union_o H/(H_{x_o} N)`, with the
   equivariant map `pi_X : h x_o |-> h H_{x_o} N`.
5. The algebra `B = Cl(Y) rtimes Q`, with `tau_B(sum a_q u_q) = tau_Y(a_e)`,
   is finite dimensional.  Its trace is faithful because
   `tau_B(x^* x) = sum_q tau_Y(a_q^* a_q)`.  So `B` embeds in `R`.
6. Under `c_x |-> c_{pi_X(x)}` and `u_h |-> u_{pi(h)}`, the model word is
   `c_{pi_X(y_1)} ... c_{pi_X(y_m)} u_{pi(q)}`.  By step 3, `pi(q) = e` if
   and only if `q = e`, and the labels `pi_X(y_j)` have the same equality
   pattern as the `y_j`.
7. By the word reduction, every moment of length at most `n` agrees exactly.
   The criterion gives Connes embeddability.

Heredity to subgroups follows by intersecting the separating normal
subgroups with the subgroup.
